method: Cook the beef mince with the Sichuan Chilli until done and nicely coloured.
Warm the flatbreads and spread with yoghurt or mayo.
Fill with the beef mince, mangetout and cherry tomatoes and salad, roll up tightly and serve.

name: Harissa Pork Skillet
blurb: Harissa pork with sweetcorn and chard, served with couscous or grains.
method: Fry the pork in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned all over.
Add the sweetcorn and chard, then stir in the Harissa with a splash of water and simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce clings.
Check the seasoning and serve with couscous or grains.

name: Preserved Lemon & Olive Chicken Thigh Bake
blurb: Preserved Lemon & Olive chicken thigh with peas, served with pasta.
method: Heat the oven to 190C fan. Layer the chicken thigh, peas and Preserved Lemon & Olive in a baking dish.
Top with cheese or breadcrumbs and bake for 30-35 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes, then serve with pasta.

name: Maple & Bacon Chicken Breast with Pan Sauce
blurb: Chicken Breast and sweetcorn in a maple & bacon pan sauce.
method: Season the chicken breast well and fry in a hot pan with a little oil for 3-4 minutes each side.
Lift out to rest, add the Maple & Bacon to the pan and let it bubble into a sauce, then return the chicken breast to coat.
Serve with the sweetcorn and a green salad.

name: Tikka Masala Cauliflower Traybake
blurb: Cauliflower and fennel in a tikka masala traybake.
method: Heat the oven to 200C fan. Tip the Cauliflower, fennel and Tikka Masala into a large roasting tin with oil and seasoning and toss.
Roast for 30-35 minutes, turning once, until the cauliflower is cooked through and everything is golden at the edges.
Serve straight from the tin with potatoes.

name: Saffron & Tomato Lamb Mince Slow-Cooked
blurb: Lamb Mince cooked slow-cooked-style in a saffron & tomato sauce with chard and butternut squash.
method: Brown the lamb mince, then add the Saffron & Tomato, chard and butternut squash and enough liquid to almost cover.
Cover and cook low for 3-4 hours (or a slow cooker on low for 7-8) until meltingly tender.
Shred or leave in chunks and serve over potatoes.

name: Sumac & Lemon Butter Bean Soup
blurb: Butter Bean cooked soup-style in a sumac & lemon sauce with cherry tomatoes.
method: Soften a chopped onion, then add the Sumac & Lemon and cook for a minute.
Add the butter bean, cherry tomatoes and 1.2 litres of stock and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Blend to your liking or leave it chunky, then serve with noodles.

name: Sesame & Ginger Sausage Stir-Fry
blurb: Sausage cooked stir-fry-style in a sesame & ginger sauce with red onion and red peppers.
method: Get a wok smoking hot. Stir-fry the sausage for 3-4 minutes until seared, then lift out.
Stir-fry the red onion and red peppers for 2 minutes, return the sausage, pour in the Sesame & Ginger and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Pile onto rice.

name: Maple & Bacon Aubergine Rice Bowl
blurb: Aubergine and cherry tomatoes in a maple & bacon rice bowl.
method: Cook the couscous or grains and divide between bowls.
Cook the aubergine with the Maple & Bacon until glazed and just done, adding the cherry tomatoes to wilt or char.
Spoon over the bowls with any extra dressing and a scatter of seeds or herbs.

name: Sumac & Lemon Mushroom Skewers

Thread onto skewers with the baby spinach and leeks and grill or griddle for 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
